tool.name: 3DTrees: SmartTile
tool.description: Tile, filter, merge and remap point clouds

param.name: resolution_1_cm
param.label: Resolution of the high-resolution tiles (cm)
param.help: Resolution of the high-resolution tiles from the tile task, 1–100 cm (typically 1 cm). It sets the matching radius, the 3D voxel diagonal (17.32 mm at 1 cm).

param.name: mode
param.label: Prod-merged resolution
param.help: Subsampled keeps one original point per voxel; full resolution keeps every input point in record order (for example as input to ForestStructure).

param.name: merged_resolution_cm
param.label: Prod-merged resolution (cm)
param.help: Target spacing for prod-merged outputs, 1–100 cm.

param.label: Add OriginalPointIndex
param.help: Numbers every point by its record position across the input files (sorted by name), as the first ExtraByte (uint64 in LAZ/COPC; uint32 in full-resolution PLY, with an error on overflow). ForestStructure uses it to restore source record order after COPC reorders points.

param.label: Prod-merged formats
param.help: Select one or more output encodings for prod-merged products.

param.name: input_files
param.label: Input LAZ/LAS files
param.help: One or more source point clouds to tile and subsample.

param.name: mode
param.label: Tiling mode
param.option: Keep existing instances whole for species prediction

param.label: Instance dimension
param.help: Existing tree ID field, for example PredInstance_SAT or PredInstance_FM.

validator.message: Use a dimension name starting with a letter or underscore.

param.name: resolution_cm
param.label: Instance-tile resolution (cm)
param.help: Keeps one original point per instance and voxel. This replaces the subsampled-output entries below.

param.name: attributes
param.label: Additional attributes to retain
param.help: Comma-separated fields, such as intensity. The instance field is always retained.

param.label: Tile length (m)
param.help: Target tile edge length in meters.

param.label: Tile buffer (m)
param.help: Overlap added around each tile in meters. The tile grid always starts at the south-west corner of the data extent.

param.label: Tiling threshold (MB)
param.help: Skip tiling for a single input below this size and still create normalized subsampled outputs.

param.label: Subsampling method
param.help: Point kept for each voxel: center of mass is the mean of the original points in the voxel; nearest to centroid is the original point closest to that mean.

repeat.name: tile_outputs
repeat.title: Subsampled output
repeat.help: One collection per entry, in this order (first entry = subsampled output 1). Each resolution may appear only once. All resolutions come from one read of the inputs. Typically a low resolution (10 cm) for the segmentation models and a high resolution (1 cm) as merge geometry.

param.name: resolution_cm
param.label: Resolution (cm)
param.help: Voxel size, 1–100 cm. Every resolution is computed from the original points.

param.name: format
param.label: Format
param.help: COPC LAZ only for viewers or spatial reads; SmartTile merge accepts LAZ and COPC LAZ. PLY is binary XYZ with the CRS as a comment line.

param.name: type
param.label: Model
param.help: The model that produced the segmented files.
param.option: SegmentAnyTree, ForestMamba or other point predictions

param.label: Instance dimension
param.help: Name of the prediction instance dimension in the segmented files, for example PredInstance_SAT or PredInstance_FM.

validator.message: Use letters, numbers, and underscores only; start with a letter or underscore.

param.name: input_tree_files
param.label: Tree tables from 3dtrees_raycloudtools
param.help: Both the *_trees.txt and *_trees_info.txt table for every segmented tile; required to keep whole trees and their tree IDs.

param.name: input_tree_meshes
param.label: QSM tree meshes from 3dtrees_raycloudtools
param.help: Optional: the *_trees_mesh.ply of every segmented tile (RayCloudTools 1.3.0 or newer, with per-face tree IDs). Filtered with the same IDs as the tiles and tables.

param.name: input_segmented
param.label: Primary segmented files
param.help: Segmented prediction files, in the same tile layout as the high-resolution tiles.

param.name: input_res1
param.label: High-resolution tiles
param.help: The high-resolution subsampled tiles from the tile task (typically 1 cm): merge transfers the predictions onto them.

param.name: input_original_laz
param.label: Original LAZ/LAS files
param.help: Original uploaded files to enrich with predictions and use for prod-merged outputs.

param.name: tile_bounds_json
param.label: Tile bounds JSON
param.help: Tile bounds JSON emitted by the tile task for the same tiling run.

param.name: prediction_transfer_cm
param.label: Prediction transfer radius (cm)
param.help: Every high-resolution point takes the predictions of the nearest segmented point within this 3D distance, and every point must find one. The default, 17.32 cm, is the voxel diagonal of 10 cm segmentation tiles; for coarser segmentation tiles use 1.732 × their resolution (for example 34.64 cm at 20 cm).

param.label: Ownership anchor
param.help: Point of each instance whose XY position decides which tile core owns it; the centroid is the XY centroid.

param.name: enabled
param.label: Cross-tile instance reconciliation
param.help: Give retained instances that continue across a tile boundary one shared ID. Not used with RayCloudTools tree tables (whole trees keep their tile-local identity).

param.label: Overlap threshold
param.help: Minimum shared-point ratio for reconciling instances across tiles, above 0 and at most 1.

validator.message: The overlap threshold must be above 0 and at most 1.

param.name: enabled
param.label: Small cluster reassignment
param.help: After deduplication, give small instances the ID of the remaining instance with the nearest XY centroid (horizontal distance, within 5 m). Not available for RayCloudTools.

param.label: Max bounding-box volume (m3)
param.help: Instances below this axis-aligned bounding-box volume are small.

param.label: Max cluster size (points)
param.help: Only instances with fewer points on the high-resolution tiles are checked against the volume limit.

param.name: input_files
param.label: Dense segmented tiles
param.help: Already-dense prediction tiles with instance IDs. Whole-instance tiles are already owned and do not need this step.

param.name: tile_bounds_json
param.label: Tile bounds JSON
param.help: Layout from the same tiling run; a buffer width alone is insufficient.

param.label: Instance dimension
param.help: Existing tree ID field, for example PredInstance_SAT or PredInstance_FM.

validator.message: Use a dimension name starting with a letter or underscore.

param.label: Ownership anchor
param.help: Point of each instance whose XY position decides which tile core owns it; the centroid is the XY centroid.

param.name: reconcile_instances
param.label: Reconcile matching instances across tiles
param.help: Give overlapping predictions of the same tree one shared ID. Disable when existing IDs already identify complete trees.

param.label: Overlap threshold
param.help: Minimum shared-point ratio when reconciliation is enabled.

param.name: merged_file
param.label: Merged LAZ/COPC LAZ file
param.help: Single merged prediction file whose extra dimensions should be transferred to originals.

param.name: merged_file_is_copc

param.help: Preserve the .copc.laz suffix for tools that infer COPC status from the file name.

param.name: collection
param.label: Segmented files collection
param.help: Filtered/merged high-resolution tiles of one model, as produced by the merge task (optionally after DetailView).

param.name: type
param.label: Model
param.help: RayCloudTools collections also need the filtered tree tables from the merge task.
param.option: SegmentAnyTree, ForestMamba or other point predictions

param.name: tree_files
param.label: RayCloudTools tree tables
param.help: The filtered *_trees.txt and *_trees_info.txt tables emitted by the merge task.

param.name: tree_meshes
param.label: RayCloudTools QSM tree meshes
param.help: Optional: the filtered tree meshes emitted by the merge task.

param.label: Dimension allowlist
param.help: Comma-separated extra dimensions to transfer; empty transfers all extra dimensions.

validator.message: Use comma-separated dimension names containing only letters, numbers, and underscores.

param.label: Instance dimension
param.help: For a custom tree ID field, enter the same name used for whole-instance tiling (for example CustomTreeId). PredInstance-prefixed fields and treeID are also recognized automatically. A custom field name applies to every prediction collection in this run.

validator.message: Use a dimension name starting with a letter or underscore.

param.label: Match within the same existing instance
param.help: For species predictions from whole-instance tiles: originals and predictions must contain the same instance field selected above. Copy attributes only from the same tree and preserve its ID.

param.name: original_files
param.label: Original LAZ/LAS files
param.help: Original uploaded files to enrich with remapped prediction dimensions.

param.name: original_with_predictions
param.label: Original-with-predictions files
param.help: Original files that already contain prediction dimensions.

repeat.name: additional_versions
repeat.title: Further version of the same originals
repeat.help: Add the same original files with the attributes of another segmentation output (for example a second remap run). Files are matched by name and must hold the same points in the same record order; every version's attributes are combined into one product. An attribute in several versions must have equal values.

param.label: Output formats
param.help: Select one or more output encodings for prod-merged products.

collection.name: output_remap_tree_meshes
collection.label: ${tool.name}: RayCloudTools QSM tree meshes per original
collection.filter: operation['task'] == "remap" or (operation['task'] == "merge" and operation['input_original_laz'] and operation['model']['type'] == "raycloudtools")

collection.name: output_remap_tree_files
collection.label: ${tool.name}: RayCloudTools tree tables per original
collection.filter: operation['task'] == "remap" or (operation['task'] == "merge" and operation['input_original_laz'] and operation['model']['type'] == "raycloudtools")

collection.name: prod_merged_outputs
collection.label: ${tool.name}: Prod-merged LAZ/COPC products
collection.filter: (operation['task'] == "create_merged_file" and ("laz" in operation['merged_output_formats'] or "copc.laz" in operation['merged_output_formats'])) or (operation['task'] == "remap" and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and ("laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'] or "copc.laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'])) or (operation['task'] == "merge" and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and operation['input_original_laz'] and ("laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'] or "copc.laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats']))

collection.name: prod_merged_ply_outputs
collection.label: ${tool.name}: Prod-merged PLY products
collection.filter: (operation['task'] == "create_merged_file" and "ply" in operation['merged_output_formats']) or (operation['task'] == "remap" and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and "ply" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats']) or (operation['task'] == "merge" and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and operation['input_original_laz'] and "ply" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'])

tool.help:
**SmartTile 2.4 workflows**
1. Original → Tile → SegmentAnyTree/ForestMamba → Filter/Merge → species prediction → Remap → visualization. Create fine (typically 1 cm) and coarse (10 cm) spatial tiles. Filter/Merge transfers coarse predictions to the fine geometry and resolves overlaps using the matching tile bounds JSON. Give Remap each model's final prediction collection and the originals. 2. Original with predictions → whole-instance Tile → species prediction → same-instance Remap → visualization. Choose "Keep existing instances whole", select the existing ID field and the instance-tile resolution. Every tree stays in exactly one tile, and that field is always retained. These tiles need no separate filter. For already-dense buffered prediction tiles, use Filter with their original tile bounds JSON before species prediction. Plain spatial tiles contain geometry, not existing tree IDs. 3. Multiple segmentation attribute versions → Create prod-merged file → full-resolution COPC → ForestStructure. Add versions of the same originals under "Further version": filenames and point order must agree; shared fields must contain equal values. Different original files go in the primary input list. Choose full resolution, COPC LAZ and "Add OriginalPointIndex".
**Tiling and filtering**
Inputs must share a projected CRS in metres, or all have no CRS and use local metres. Reproject degree, geocentric or foot-based inputs first. Spatial tiles use buffered cores; the subsampled-output entries control their resolution and format. Whole-instance mode instead uses its own single resolution and writes LAZ with XYZ, its required instance field and any selected additional attributes. IDs must already be globally meaningful across the input files.
Filter/Merge transfers every fine point within the prediction transfer radius (17.32 cm by default), then applies core ownership, reconciliation and duplicate removal. Filter starts with already-dense predictions and skips the prediction-transfer step; cross-tile reconciliation can be disabled for existing global identities. Both require the tile bounds JSON from the same layout. Optional small-cluster reassignment in Filter/Merge changes IDs only and is disabled by default.
RayCloudTools merge/remap requires both tree tables for every tile. Optional QSM meshes must carry per-face tree IDs. Tables and meshes follow the same retained IDs. Use the model-specific merge path for RCT, not the standalone dense filter. Supplying originals to Filter/Merge also returns enriched originals; creating merged products requires them.
**Remapping**
Every non-RCT collection must cover 100% of the original points within the fine-resolution voxel diagonal (17.32 mm at 1 cm). Set the resolution to match the supplied predictions. RCT points without a surviving tree become background zero. Same-instance remap copies attributes only from the matching existing tree and keeps original IDs; use it for whole-instance species outputs. Set Instance dimension to the field used for whole-instance tiling when its name is custom (for example CustomTreeId); originals and predictions must both carry that field. The default PredInstance also recognizes PredInstance-prefixed fields and treeID automatically. Use separate remap runs for collections with different custom field names. Equal-distance choices are deterministic across worker and batch counts.
**Products and metadata**
Subsampled products retain an original point nearest each voxel mean. Full-resolution products retain every point and normally add a source-order index as the first ExtraByte. LAZ/COPC stores this index as uint64; full-resolution PLY stores uint32 and fails if an index or total count exceeds 4,294,967,295. Disabling index generation preserves an existing field. ForestStructure needs full-resolution COPC with the index enabled.
LAZ/COPC preserve compatible CRS, attributes and missing-value declarations; incompatible source schemas fail explicitly. PLY is binary and carries CRS as a comment, but cannot represent LAS missing-value declarations or general 64-bit integer fields. COPC is returned to Galaxy with the LAZ datatype. Input files are staged read-only; duplicate names and unsafe paths fail before processing.
CPU usage follows Galaxy's allocation. Dense cells can exceed the tiler's point-count target; the scheduler/container enforces the job RAM limit. Large jobs also need scratch disk. This wrapper does not change the server's resource allocation.
